Hi Alicia / Tom —

Appreciate the prompt. Attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a companion eval test matrix (eval-test-cases.csv). High-level summary below — happy to iterate with Tom's team.

Goals / success definition
- Clinical concordance >= 92% on the sampled validation set (see test matrix)
- Median end-to-end latency <= 1200ms for 95th percentile traffic profile
- No high-severity hallucinations in the 200-case audit (defined in test matrix)

Exit gates (fail-fast rules)
- Safety exit: any single high-severity hallucination causing clinical risk -> immediate stop and triage
- Performance exit: sustained P95 latency > 2000ms for >30 minutes during test window
- Quality exit: week-over-week regression of concordance > 3 percentage points vs baseline

Acceptance tests (concrete)
1) Concordance sweep — 200 randomized cases run through prod variant; threshold >= 92%
2) Hallucination audit — 200-case manual review (binary high/low severity)
3) Latency profile — synthetic and live traffic runs measuring P50/P95/P99
4) Regression smoke — run previous baseline prompts and ensure no degradation

Owners & timeline (proposed 5-week sprint)
- Week 0: Kickoff + dataset handoff (CarePlus: Tom; Redwood: Ben)
- Week 1–2: Integration + smoke tests (Ben)
- Week 3: Concordance & hallucination sweep (Tom + clinical reviewers)
- Week 4: Latency stress + billing/sample analysis (Redwood infra)
- Week 5: Review & sign-off / optional rollback window (Alicia + Logan)

Deliverables pinned in the spreadsheet: owner email, artifact links, and pass/fail columns. If happy, we'll convert this into the SOW appendix for procurement.

Notes on mitigations: we recommend a canary with reduced traffic and automatic fallback to a cheaper model variant if latency spikes. We'll document rollback steps in the runbook.

I've attached short test-case examples in eval-test-cases.csv and the MAP slides are summarized in the spreadsheet.

Next step: quick alignment call with Tom's reviewers — are mornings this week OK?

Best,
